desc: The MK2 is a powerful, handmade knife crafted in the USA from durable 1095 high carbon steel, designed for knife enthusiasts and survivalists who demand performance. Created in collaboration with an active-duty tier one operator, the MK2 features a sleek and slim design, built for precision and strength in demanding situations. Its stabby blade excels at piercing and cutting, while the nitrile handle ensures a secure, non-slip grip even in wet conditions. Whether you're handling survival tasks or tactical missions, the MK2 offers the durability and functionality you need. With its superior construction and practical design, the MK2 is a must-have tool for those who rely on quality and performance.
